rows.text: The company is narrowing its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $6.70 to $6.80 and reaffirming its long-term adjusted EPS growth rate of 5% to 7% through 2030 off the 2025 guidance range midpoint of $6.30, with confidence to earn in the top half of the range beginning in 2028.
▪ Second-quarter 2026 reported EPS of $1.38 and adjusted EPS of $1.43; strong first half positions company to deliver full-year results within guidance range
